purpose: Track AI leaders, AI founders and AI wealth patterns, then convert public signals into monetization actions.

watchlist.name: Jensen Huang
watchlist.wealth_pattern: picks_and_shovels: GPUs, networking, AI factories, software ecosystem
watchlist.what_to_learn: Control the scarce bottleneck and become infrastructure for everyone else.
watchlist.our_small_version: AI cost-per-task tracker, warehouse AI workflows, model routing and automation infrastructure.

watchlist.name: Sam Altman
watchlist.wealth_pattern: model platform + subscriptions + API + enterprise + infrastructure partnerships
watchlist.what_to_learn: Turn frontier capability into simple products and developer platforms.
watchlist.our_small_version: Use best available models to create outcome-based SMB automations and parts commerce workflows.

watchlist.name: Dario Amodei
watchlist.wealth_pattern: trusted enterprise model + cloud partnerships + coding/workflow agents
watchlist.what_to_learn: Trust, safety, enterprise readiness and cloud distribution can be monetized.
watchlist.our_small_version: Sell reliable, scoped, QA-checked automations instead of vague AI experiments.

watchlist.name: Demis Hassabis
watchlist.wealth_pattern: research advantage + Google distribution + multimodal models
watchlist.what_to_learn: Deep research becomes product advantage when tied to distribution.
watchlist.our_small_version: Research-heavy pricing and fitment logic packaged into practical listing/pricing tools.

watchlist.name: Satya Nadella
watchlist.wealth_pattern: bundle AI into existing enterprise distribution: Office, Azure, GitHub, Dynamics
watchlist.what_to_learn: Distribution beats pure technology when products are embedded into daily workflow.
watchlist.our_small_version: Embed AI into existing seller workflows: intake, pricing, listing, orders and follow-up.

watchlist.name: Sundar Pichai
watchlist.wealth_pattern: AI inside search, ads, Android, Workspace, Cloud and TPUs
watchlist.what_to_learn: Own discovery and distribution, then AI becomes default behavior.
watchlist.our_small_version: Make parts data structured and discoverable for AI search/shopping agents.

watchlist.name: Andy Jassy
watchlist.wealth_pattern: sell infrastructure, managed AI services and marketplace access
watchlist.what_to_learn: Be the reliable backend for many AI applications.
watchlist.our_small_version: Create backend workflows for sellers: inventory, pricing, listing, shipment and support.

watchlist.name: Mark Zuckerberg
watchlist.wealth_pattern: open models + social distribution + talent acquisitions + data advantage
watchlist.what_to_learn: Distribution and talent can be bought, but product-market fit still matters.
watchlist.our_small_version: Use open models where enough, keep costs low, build domain data advantage.

watchlist.name: Elon Musk
watchlist.wealth_pattern: integrate AI with physical world, compute, robotics, vehicles, social data and infrastructure
watchlist.what_to_learn: Big systems compound when software, hardware, distribution and data feed each other.
watchlist.our_small_version: Parts warehouse OS should connect photos, barcodes, locations, pricing and future physical automation.

watchlist.name: Alexandr Wang
watchlist.wealth_pattern: data labeling, model evaluation, enterprise/government AI infrastructure
watchlist.what_to_learn: Unsexy data infrastructure can create huge value if it is mission-critical.
watchlist.our_small_version: Parts data normalization, fitment quality, pricing datasets, listing audits.

watchlist.name: Michael Truell / Cursor founders
watchlist.wealth_pattern: AI coding IDE, seat subscriptions, usage monetization, developer workflow lock-in
watchlist.what_to_learn: Take one expensive expert workflow and make it 10x faster inside the tool where work happens.
watchlist.our_small_version: Use Cursor internally; later sell setup/service for coding-agent business automations.

watchlist.name: Aravind Srinivas
watchlist.wealth_pattern: AI answer/search engine, subscriptions, browser/agent distribution, possible commerce/search ads
watchlist.what_to_learn: Search can be rebuilt around answers and actions, not blue links.
watchlist.our_small_version: Parts market answer engine: find price, fitment, competitor supply and listing gaps.

watchlist.name: Mati Staniszewski / Piotr Dabkowski
watchlist.wealth_pattern: voice generation, API, creator/pro enterprise subscriptions, localization and agents
watchlist.what_to_learn: A narrow media capability can become a platform if quality is high and API is easy.
watchlist.our_small_version: Voice/video listing descriptions, multilingual parts content, training SOP narration.

watchlist.name: Harvey founders
watchlist.wealth_pattern: legal workflow AI, enterprise contracts, domain trust, high-value compliance workflows
watchlist.what_to_learn: Choose a high-value domain where time saved is worth a premium.
watchlist.our_small_version: Parts pricing/listing workflows where mistakes cost money and inventory turns matter.

watchlist.name: Abridge founders
watchlist.wealth_pattern: clinical documentation, ambient workflow capture, healthcare system contracts
watchlist.what_to_learn: Capture messy real-world conversations and convert them into structured records.
watchlist.our_small_version: Capture messy part intake/photos/codes and convert to structured listing/location/pricing records.
